sections.title: Command Registry
sections.content: Defines owner-owned RED and GREEN validation commands for canonical evidence, migration, bootstrap runtime, acceptance pipeline, projection/segmentation, semantic import, and rollout regression. Terminal validation requires all listed GREEN programs. Commands are non-shell Python invocations with bounded timeouts and mapped acceptance IDs; no authorization is granted.

sections.title: Requirements And Acceptance
sections.content: Defines ARBE-001 through ARBE-022 and observable acceptance criteria. Core requirements cover identity-bound admission, complete changed-set and typed closure, real checks, policy routes and mode matrix, isolated review roles, immutable range projections and segment descriptors, runtime progress/retry controls, canonical evidence migration, historical evidence preservation, telemetry, Bootstrap import constraints, and Acceptance-only lifecycle publication. Bootstrap evidence and supervised fast-path decisions are non-authorizing; required triggers upgrade routing independently of cost.
